resources.string: Choose a storage mode first. Application data stays in app-owned storage; official ES-DE data is never adopted.

ROM folder: %1$s How to add games: connect USB, install Android platform tools on your computer, enable USB debugging, and authorize the computer. Run adb push your-ROM-folder/. %2$s/ (organize games into system folders such as nes). No storage permission is required. Uninstalling removes app-owned games. Import through a file picker is not available yet.
Compatibility mode requires broad storage access. Select your shared ROM folder after granting access. A SAF selection alone does not provide the native filesystem access this mode needs.
Selected ROM folder: %1$s How to add games: copy them here with USB file transfer or a file manager, in system folders such as nes.
Configuration cancelled. Your selections are kept on this screen. Choose a mode and retry when ready; startup will wait for you.
Folder selection cancelled. The previous selection has been kept. If the picker did not open, use a typed folder path below or choose app-owned storage.
Access was not granted. Retry or explicitly choose app-owned storage.
All-files settings are unavailable on this device. Choose app-owned storage, or enable all-files access in the device settings and return here.
A folder picker is unavailable. Enter an absolute local ROM folder path below, or choose app-owned storage.
Configuration failed. Check the storage and retry.
Resource installation failed. Restore available storage or remove the obstruction, then retry. Your games and settings are kept.
